subject: Behavioral Economics
title: The Pain of Paying
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Pain of Paying usable.

hook.text: The Pain of Paying: a simple choice shows how real behavior departs from strict rationality.

buildup.text: The Pain of Paying sets up the incentives, biases, and tradeoffs driving the choice.

discovery.text: The Pain of Paying reveals the behavioral mechanism driving the outcome.

twist.text: Subscriptions exploit this. A monthly $14.99 feels painless until you realize you're paying $180 per year for a service.

climax.text: To feel the real cost, pay with cash for one week. The physical handover restores the pain that digital payments hide.

punchline.text: If paying does not sting, you are spending too easily.

quiz.question: Why do credit cards increase spending?
options: They reduce the felt pain of paying compared to cash
They allow people to buy things they cannot afford
